--disable-check.help: Disable a specific lint check by its ID

--ignore.help: Ignore files/directories containing this path substring

--list-checks.help: List all available lint check IDs and descriptions

--local.help: Adds support for local/side-by-side installation (sets rpath if needed)

--nosudo.help: Do not use sudo for install/symstall/uninstall

--project.help: Create a visual studio project and do not build.

--release.help: Set the build as Release (remove debug info)

--shared.help: Link dynamically (shared library) rather than statically

-A.help: Run aaa or aaaa after loading each binary (see -C).

-B.help: Define the base address to add the offsets when listing.

-G.help: Run an r2 command on every RCore instance created.

-O.help: Code diffing with opcode bytes only.

-S.help: Sort code diff (name, namelen, addr, size, type, dist) (only for -C or -g).

-T.help: Analyze files in threads (EXPERIMENTAL, 30% faster and crashy).

-a.help: Specify architecture plugin to use (x86, arm, etc.).

-b.help: Specify register size for architecture (16 (thumb), 32, 64, etc.).

-binary.help: location of binary to use for clang-format

-e.help: Set eval config var value for all RCore instances.

-f.help: Interpret the input file as a FLIRT 'I.sig' file and dump its signatures.

-g.help: Graph diff of [sym] or functions in [off1,off2].

-i.help: apply edits to files instead of displaying a diff

-iregex.help: custom pattern selecting file paths to reformat (case insensitive, overridden by -regex)

-o.help: Add generated signatures to the specified file. Creates the file if it does not exist.

-p.help: strip the smallest prefix containing P slashes

-regex.help: custom pattern selecting file paths to reformat (case sensitive, overrides -iregex)

-s.help: Compute edit distance (no substitution, Eugene W. Myers O(ND) diff algorithm).

-ss.help: Compute Levenshtein edit distance (substitution is allowed, O(N^2)).

-style.help: formatting style to apply (LLVM, Google, Chromium, Mozilla, WebKit)

-t.help: Set threshold for code diff (default is 70%).
